title: TaskFrame: Connecting Task-Level Planning with Frame-Level Control for Game Agents
title_zh: TaskFrame：将任务级规划与帧级控制相连接的游戏智能体

paragraphs.en: Building general game agents requires both high-level task reasoning and low-latency action control in rapidly changing visual environments. These capabilities favor models with substantially different computational profiles, making them difficult to realize within a single model. In this work, we present TaskFrame, a hierarchical planner–controller framework that connects task-level planning with frame-level keyboard-and-mouse control. A vision-language task planner decomposes a high-level goal into an ordered sequence of atomic instructions and is optimized through supervised learning and dependency-aware GRPO. The hidden states of special goal tokens that terminate each atomic instruction provide continuous goal embeddings that are cached and reused across control steps. A causal Transformer controller combines the embedding of the active goal with recent observations to predict discrete keyboard and mouse-button actions and continuous camera motion at every game step. We train the system in three stages: planner training, controller pretraining, and joint alignment. Experiments in Minecraft show that TaskFrame is competitive with general-purpose vision-language models on instruction decomposition, and that in closed-loop evaluation the agent achieves a higher combat success rate than the evaluated baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 构建通用游戏智能体既需要高层任务推理，也需要在快速变化的视觉环境中进行低延迟的动作控制。 这两种能力要求模型的计算特征差异巨大，因此难以在单一模型中同时实现。 在本工作中，我们提出 TaskFrame，这是一个分层规划器-控制器框架，将任务级规划与帧级键鼠控制相连接。 视觉语言任务规划器将高层目标分解为有序的原子指令序列，并通过监督学习和依赖感知的 GRPO 进行优化。 终止每条原子指令的特殊目标词元的隐藏状态提供了连续的目标嵌入，这些嵌入会被缓存并在多个控制步骤中复用。 因果 Transformer 控制器在每个游戏步骤中，将当前激活目标的嵌入与近期观测相结合，以预测离散的键盘和鼠标按键动作以及连续的相机运动。 我们分三个阶段训练该系统：规划器训练、控制器预训练和联合对齐。 在 Minecraft 中的实验表明，TaskFrame 在指令分解方面与通用视觉语言模型具有竞争力，并且在闭环评估中，该智能体取得了比所评估基线更高的战斗成功率。

paragraphs.en: Games have long been a demanding testbed for artificial general intelligence (AGI), as successful gameplay requires the integration of perception, reasoning, planning, and decision making into goal-directed behavior. Existing efforts have reached or surpassed expert human performance in board games, Atari, multiplayer poker, and complex real-time strategy games ( Silver et al., 2016 ; Silver et al., 2017 ; Schrittwieser et al., 2020 ; OpenAI et al., 2019 ; Badia et al., 2020 ; Brown and Sandholm, 2019 ; Vinyals et al., 2019 ) . More recently, research has shifted toward embodied game agents that follow language instructions and act directly from pixels in open-ended virtual worlds ( SIMA Team, 2025 ; Magne et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Hafner et al., 2025 ) . Unlike agents specialized for a fixed environment or objective, such systems provide a natural setting for studying whether an agent can understand diverse goals, adapt its behavior to changing visual situations, and execute complex tasks through a general action interface.
paragraphs.zh: 游戏长期以来一直是通用人工智能（AGI）的高要求试验场，因为成功的游戏过程需要将感知、推理、规划和决策整合到目标导向的行为中。 现有的研究工作已经在棋盘游戏、Atari、多人扑克以及复杂的即时战略游戏中达到或超越了人类专家水平（ Silver et al., 2016 ; Silver et al., 2017 ; Schrittwieser et al., 2020 ; OpenAI et al., 2019 ; Badia et al., 2020 ; Brown and Sandholm, 2019 ; Vinyals et al., 2019 ）。 最近，研究已经转向遵循语言指令并在开放式虚拟世界中直接从像素出发进行行动的具身游戏智能体（ SIMA Team, 2025 ; Magne et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Hafner et al., 2025 ）。 与针对固定环境或固定目标而专门化的智能体不同，此类系统为研究以下问题提供了自然的场景：智能体能否理解多样化的目标、能否使其行为适应不断变化的视觉情境，以及能否通过一个通用的动作接口执行复杂任务。

paragraphs.en: Building such an embodied agent remains difficult because task-level reasoning and frame-level control operate at different frequencies. Understanding a scene, grounding an instruction, and determining the correct sequence of subgoals require a large, high-capacity model. In contrast, executing those subgoals requires a lightweight controller that can continuously incorporate the latest frame and emit actions with low latency. This challenge is especially evident in visually dynamic games, where abrupt camera motion and sudden events must be handled through a hybrid action space combining discrete keyboard presses with continuous mouse movement. Running a large reasoning model at every control step is prohibitively expensive, whereas a small reactive policy alone lacks the semantic capacity to reliably interpret and organize complex instructions and visual history.
paragraphs.zh: 构建这样的具身智能体仍然很困难，因为任务级推理和帧级控制以不同的频率运行。 理解场景、将指令接地以及确定正确的子目标序列，都需要一个大容量、高性能的模型。 相比之下，执行这些子目标需要一个轻量级控制器，能够持续纳入最新帧并以低延迟输出动作。 这一挑战在视觉动态游戏中尤为明显，在这类游戏中，突发的镜头运动和突发事件必须通过将离散的键盘按键与连续的鼠标移动相结合的混合动作空间来处理。 在每个控制步骤都运行大型推理模型的代价过于高昂，而仅靠小型反应式策略又缺乏可靠解释和组织复杂指令与视觉历史所需的语义能力。

paragraphs.en: Existing work addresses parts of this tension through several strategies. Hierarchical agents use a language model to select skills or produce high-level plans for a goal-conditioned controller ( Ahn et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023c ; Yuan et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025b ) . In physical robotics, dual-system Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models separate a slower semantic module from a faster visuomotor policy ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Figure AI, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Bu et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) , while action chunking amortizes inference by predicting multiple actions at once, with recent methods improving parallel decoding or asynchronous execution ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2025 ) . A practical game agent must connect these mechanisms through an interface that supports both structured planning and responsive control. The high-level model must translate an open-vocabulary goal into a complete and correctly ordered sequence of atomic goals, and the controller must keep incorporating the latest visual observation at every action step.
paragraphs.zh: 现有工作通过若干策略来应对这一张力中的部分问题。 分层智能体使用语言模型来选择技能或为目标条件控制器生成高层计划（Ahn et al., 2022；Wang et al., 2023c；Yuan et al., 2023；Li et al., 2025b）。 在物理机器人领域，双系统视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将较慢的语义模块与较快的视觉运动策略分离开来（NVIDIA et al., 2025；Figure AI, 2025；Zhang et al., 2024；Bu et al., 2024；Shi et al., 2025），而动作分块通过一次预测多个动作来摊销推理开销，近期方法则改进了并行解码或异步执行（Kim et al., 2025；Black et al., 2025）。 一个实用的游戏智能体必须通过一个同时支持结构化规划与响应式控制的接口来连接这些机制。 高层模型必须将开放词汇目标转化为完整且顺序正确的原子目标序列，而控制器必须在每一步动作中持续纳入最新的视觉观测。

paragraphs.en: We present TaskFrame , a hierarchical game agent that connects task-level planning with frame-level control through planner-produced goal representations ( Figure 1 ). Its high-capacity task planner is trained to perform visually grounded instruction decomposition, with dedicated data and a dependency-aware reinforcement learning objective that addresses both step-count and ordering correctness. Each atomic goal it emits is terminated by a special goal token, and the hidden states at these tokens are cached and passed to a lightweight frame controller as continuous goal embeddings. The controller combines the embedding of the active goal with recent frames to emit discrete keyboard and mouse-button actions and continuous camera motion at every game step, so the large planner stays outside the frame-level control loop. We train the system in three stages: the planner is trained for decomposition, the controller is trained to produce actions from each frame, and the two modules are finally aligned jointly.

paragraphs.en: We introduce TaskFrame, a hierarchical game agent in which a vision-language planner decomposes goals once per task and conditions a frame-level keyboard-and-mouse controller, which acts at every game step, through the hidden states of special goal tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 TaskFrame，这是一种分层游戏智能体，其中视觉语言规划器在每项任务中分解一次目标，并通过特殊目标词元的隐藏状态，对在每一步游戏中执行动作的帧级键鼠控制器进行条件控制。

paragraphs.en: We propose a dependency-aware GRPO objective for instruction decomposition that rewards necessary precedence relations separately from conventional ordering, derived from pairwise dependency annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种面向指令分解的依赖感知 GRPO 目标，该目标将必要的先后关系与常规排序分开进行奖励，其依据是成对依赖标注。

paragraphs.en: We propose a three-stage training recipe that pretrains the controller with a generic goal encoder and then aligns it with the planner through LoRA adapters, and we equip the controller with a hybrid discrete and flow-matching action head. We evaluate the planner on two decomposition benchmarks and the full agent in closed-loop Minecraft control.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出一种三阶段训练方案：先使用通用目标编码器对控制器进行预训练，然后通过 LoRA 适配器将其与规划器对齐，并为控制器配备混合的离散与流匹配动作头。 我们在两个分解基准上评估规划器，并在闭环 Minecraft 控制中评估完整智能体。

paragraphs.en: MineRL and VPT established large-scale imitation from human Minecraft play ( Guss et al., 2019 ; Baker et al., 2022 ) , and MineDojo added an open-ended environment with internet-scale knowledge ( Fan et al., 2022 ) . STEVE-1, GROOT, ROCKET-1, and MineDreamer condition low-level policies on text, reference videos, visual-temporal prompts, or imagined goals ( Lifshitz et al., 2023 ; Cai et al., 2024b ; Cai et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) , while JARVIS-VLA and OmniJARVIS post-train VLMs to emit keyboard-and-mouse actions directly ( Li et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , following robotic VLAs ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) . Recent systems generalize across tasks and games ( Wang et al., 2025 ; SIMA Team, 2025 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2024 ) and control games through native keyboard-and-mouse interfaces at frame rate ( Yue et al., 2026 ; Magne et al., 2026 ) . TaskFrame instead connects explicit, trained task decomposition to frame-level control and keeps the large VLM outside the per-frame loop.

paragraphs.en: Language-model planners ground decisions in skill affordances ( Ahn et al., 2022 ) , use environment feedback ( Huang et al., 2022 ) , or write code over control primitives ( Liang et al., 2023 ) . In Minecraft, Plan4MC, DEPS, Voyager, JARVIS-1, and Optimus-1/2 plan over learned skills or dispatch multimodal plans to goal-conditioned controllers ( Yuan et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023b ; Wang et al., 2023a ; Wang et al., 2023c ; Li et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025b ) . These planners are prompted or supervised to produce plans but are not optimized for whether their steps respect task dependencies. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, popularized by GRPO and its variants ( Shao et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , offers a way to do so: we use the must-precede annotations of GameHorizon Suite ( Wang et al., 2026 ) to define a reward that separates necessary precedence from conventional ordering.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型规划器将决策建立在技能可供性之上（Ahn et al., 2022），利用环境反馈（Huang et al., 2022），或基于控制原语编写代码（Liang et al., 2023）。 在 Minecraft 中，Plan4MC、DEPS、Voyager、JARVIS-1 和 Optimus-1/2 基于已学习的技能进行规划，或将多模态计划分发给目标条件控制器（Yuan et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2023b；Wang et al., 2023a；Wang et al., 2023c；Li et al., 2024；Li et al., 2025b）。 这些规划器通过提示或监督来生成计划，但并未针对其步骤是否遵守任务依赖关系进行优化。 由 GRPO 及其变体推广的可验证奖励强化学习（Shao et al., 2024；DeepSeek-AI, 2025；Liu et al., 2025）提供了一种实现方式：我们利用 GameHorizon Suite（Wang et al., 2026）的必须先于标注来定义一种奖励，将必要的先后关系与惯例性顺序区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Dual-system policies pair a slow semantic module with a fast visuomotor policy ( Kahneman, 2011 ) . Hi Robot and RT-H pass language between the two ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Belkhale et al., 2024 ) , and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} predicts a textual subtask before decoding actions ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) ; HiRT, RoboDual, GR00T N1, and Helix pass latent features from a slowly updated VLM ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Bu et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Figure AI, 2025 ) , LCB trains a dedicated latent token as the bridge ( Shentu et al., 2024 ) , and Acting While Understanding updates semantic conditions asynchronously ( Yan et al., 2026 ) . Action chunking, better action tokenization, and overlapping generation with execution further improve control efficiency ( Zhao et al., 2023 ; Chi et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Pertsch et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2025 ; Shukor et al., 2025 ) . Like HiRT and LCB, TaskFrame passes latent goals from a VLM to a fast policy, but its planner is first optimized for ordered decomposition, and its latent goals are the hidden states of goal tokens emitted within that decomposition, so one planner pass yields both an interpretable plan and one embedding per step.
paragraphs.zh: 双系统策略将一个慢速语义模块与一个快速视觉运动策略配对（Kahneman, 2011）。 Hi Robot 和 RT-H 在两者之间传递语言（Shi et al., 2025; Belkhale et al., 2024），而 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 在解码动作之前先预测文本子任务（Physical Intelligence et al., 2025）；HiRT、RoboDual、GR00T N1 和 Helix 从缓慢更新的 VLM 传递潜在特征（Zhang et al., 2024; Bu et al., 2024; NVIDIA et al., 2025; Figure AI, 2025），LCB 训练一个专用的潜在 token 作为桥梁（Shentu et al., 2024），而 Acting While Understanding 则异步更新语义条件（Yan et al., 2026）。 动作分块、更好的动作 tokenization 以及生成与执行的重叠进一步提升了控制效率（Zhao et al., 2023; Chi et al., 2025; Black et al., 2024; Pertsch et al., 2025; Kim et al., 2025; Black et al., 2025; Shukor et al., 2025）。 与 HiRT 和 LCB 类似，TaskFrame 将潜在目标从 VLM 传递给快速策略，但它的规划器首先针对有序分解进行优化，其潜在目标是在该分解中发出的目标 token 的隐藏状态，因此规划器的一次运行即可同时产生一个可解释的计划以及每个步骤对应的一个嵌入。

paragraphs.en: The frame controller is a per-frame autoregressive policy that emits native keyboard-and-mouse actions from visual observations. We build on the policy-transformer design of Yue et al. (2026) , in which a causal Transformer reads a per-frame token group and produces a single action-output token that is decoded into keyboard and mouse actions. paragraphs.zh: 帧控制器是一种逐帧的自回归策略，能够从视觉观测中原生地输出键盘和鼠标操作。 我们在 Yue 等人的策略 Transformer 设计基础上进行构建。 (2026)，其中因果 Transformer 读取一个逐帧 token 组，并生成一个动作输出 token，该 token 随后被解码为键盘和鼠标操作。 我们做了两处改动：除了视觉观测之外，控制器还以规划器的视觉语言目标嵌入作为条件，并且连续的相机运动采用流匹配头进行建模，以实现平滑控制。

paragraphs.en: Inference runs at two rates. Task rate: for a high-level goal g g , the adapted planner decodes the plan ( s ^ 1 , … , s ^ k ^ ) (\hat{s}_{1},\ldots,\hat{s}_{\hat{k}}) once, without a supplied step count, emitting a goal token after every atomic goal; the hidden states at these tokens are cached as ( z 1 , … , z k ^ ) (z_{1},\ldots,z_{\hat{k}}) ( Equation 12 ). Frame rate: the controller receives only the cached embedding of the active goal, z j z_{j} , combines it with the frames and actions of the current window, and emits an action at every game step. The decoded text is available for inspection and evaluation but is not passed to the controller.
paragraphs.zh: 推理以两种速率运行。 任务速率：对于高层目标 g g，适配后的规划器一次性解码出计划 ( s ^ 1 , … , s ^ k ^ ) (\hat{s}_{1},\ldots,\hat{s}_{\hat{k}})，无需提供步数，并在每个原子目标后输出一个目标词元；这些词元处的隐藏状态被缓存为 ( z 1 , … , z k ^ ) (z_{1},\ldots,z_{\hat{k}})（公式 12）。 帧速率：控制器仅接收活动目标的缓存嵌入 z j z_{j}，将其与当前窗口的帧和动作相结合，并在每个游戏步输出一个动作。 解码出的文本可供检查和评估，但不会传递给控制器。

sents.en: Task rate: for a high-level goal g g , the adapted planner decodes the plan ( s ^ 1 , … , s ^ k ^ ) (\hat{s}_{1},\ldots,\hat{s}_{\hat{k}}) once, without a supplied step count, emitting a goal token after every atomic goal; the hidden states at these tokens are cached as ( z 1 , … , z k ^ ) (z_{1},\ldots,z_{\hat{k}}) ( Equation 12 ).
sents.zh: 任务速率：对于高层目标 g g，适配后的规划器一次性解码出计划 ( s ^ 1 , … , s ^ k ^ ) (\hat{s}_{1},\ldots,\hat{s}_{\hat{k}})，无需提供步数，并在每个原子目标后输出一个目标词元；这些词元处的隐藏状态被缓存为 ( z 1 , … , z k ^ ) (z_{1},\ldots,z_{\hat{k}})（公式 12）。

sents.en: Frame rate: the controller receives only the cached embedding of the active goal, z j z_{j} , combines it with the frames and actions of the current window, and emits an action at every game step.
sents.zh: 帧速率：控制器仅接收活动目标的缓存嵌入 z j z_{j}，将其与当前窗口的帧和动作相结合，并在每个游戏步输出一个动作。

sents.en: The decoded text is available for inspection and evaluation but is not passed to the controller.
sents.zh: 解码出的文本可供检查和评估，但不会传递给控制器。

paragraphs.en: We ask three questions: 1) Does TaskFrame act well in closed loop ( Section 4.2 )? 2) Does its planner produce good plans ( Section 4.3 )? 3) How should planning and control be connected ( Section 4.4 )?
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出三个问题：1) TaskFrame 在闭环中表现是否良好（第 4.2 节）？2) 它的规划器能否产生良好的规划（第 4.3 节）？3) 规划与控制应如何连接（第 4.4 节）？

paragraphs.en: We follow the programmatic protocol of JARVIS-VLA ( Li et al., 2025a ) and MCU ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) in MineStudio ( Cai et al., 2024a ) and evaluate two types of tasks: mine tasks place the equipped agent inside a chamber of the target block, isolating block breaking from search, and kill tasks spawn target animals a few blocks ahead of an agent holding a sword. Episodes last at most 400 steps. We compare with VPT-BC, VPT-RL ( Baker et al., 2022 ) , STEVE-1 ( Lifshitz et al., 2023 ) , and JARVIS-VLA-7B ( Li et al., 2025a ) . Task configurations and baseline settings are given in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 MineStudio（Cai et al., 2024a）中 JARVIS-VLA（Li et al., 2025a）和 MCU（Zheng et al., 2025）的程序化协议，并评估两类任务：挖掘任务将装备好的智能体放置在目标方块所在的腔室中，把破坏方块与搜索分离开来；击杀任务则在持有剑的智能体前方几个方块处生成目标动物。 每个回合最多持续 400 步。 我们与 VPT-BC、VPT-RL（Baker et al., 2022）、STEVE-1（Lifshitz et al., 2023）以及 JARVIS-VLA-7B（Li et al., 2025a）进行比较。 任务配置和基线设置见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: Soft Semantic F1 We utilize (SSF1) to measure step content on 2.1K held-out plans. The planner sees one frame and the high-level instruction without the step count, and the predicted and reference steps are matched by sentence-embedding similarity, so paraphrases are accepted while missing or redundant steps are penalized. Task2 of GameHorizon Suite ( Wang et al., 2026 ) measures step ordering on 250 questions: given the step count, the planner generates a plan, which is matched to the most similar of four candidate orderings; ties and unparseable plans count as errors. More details are provided in Section A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 软语义F1（Soft Semantic F1，简称SSF1）：我们在2.1K个保留计划上使用（SSF1）来衡量步骤内容。 规划器仅看到一帧图像和高层指令，而不含步骤数量；预测步骤与参考步骤通过句嵌入相似度进行匹配，因此改写表述会被接受，而缺失或冗余的步骤会受到惩罚。 GameHorizon套件的任务2（Wang et al., 2026）在250个问题上衡量步骤排序：给定步骤数量，规划器生成一个计划，该计划与四个候选排序中最相似的一个进行匹配；平局和无法解析的计划都计为错误。 更多细节见A.2节。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports the results. TaskFrame reaches an average kill success of 51%, compared with 31% for JARVIS-VLA-7B, and performs best on cow, sheep, and zombie. This gap is about twice the combined standard deviation. On mining, both TaskFrame and JARVIS-VLA-7B succeed in almost every episode, so this category is close to saturated in our setting. VPT-BC, VPT-RL, and STEVE-1 reach 8–15% on kill tasks and 29–62% on mining. Overall, TaskFrame achieves the best combat performance among the evaluated models while remaining on par with JARVIS-VLA-7B on mining.
paragraphs.zh: 表1报告了结果。 TaskFrame 的平均击杀成功率达到51%，而 JARVIS-VLA-7B 为31%，并且在牛、羊和僵尸上表现最佳。 这一差距约为合并标准差的两倍。 在采矿任务上，TaskFrame 和 JARVIS-VLA-7B 几乎在每个回合中都能成功，因此该类别在我们的设定中已接近饱和。 VPT-BC、VPT-RL 和 STEVE-1 在击杀任务上达到8–15%，在采矿任务上达到29–62%。 总体而言，TaskFrame 在所评估的模型中取得了最佳的战斗表现，同时在采矿任务上与 JARVIS-VLA-7B 保持相当的水平。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 2 , our 9B planner reaches an SSF1 of 0.3459 and a Task2 accuracy of 40.0%, exceeding GPT-4o and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on both metrics while remaining below the two Gemini models, which are evaluated zero-shot like the other general-purpose baselines. Over the backbone, SFT raises SSF1 from 0.2874 to 0.3312 and Task2 accuracy from 23.2% to 38.8%, and GRPO further improves both metrics and lowers the Unparsed rate from 14.0% to 11.6%. The gain in SSF1, which uses sentence embeddings rather than the reward’s step matcher and supplies no step count, indicates that GRPO does not merely fit its own reward.
paragraphs.zh: 如表2所示，我们的9B规划器达到了0.3459的SSF1和40.0%的Task2准确率，在这两项指标上均超过了GPT-4o和Qwen3.5-397B-A17B，但仍低于两个Gemini模型，后者与其他通用基线一样采用零样本方式评估。 在骨干模型上，SFT将SSF1从0.2874提升到0.3312，Task2准确率从23.2%提升到38.8%，GRPO进一步提升了这两项指标，并将未解析率从14.0%降低到11.6%。 SSF1使用句子嵌入而非奖励的步骤匹配器，且不提供步骤数量，其提升表明GRPO并非仅仅拟合其自身的奖励。

paragraphs.en: To isolate the value of the hierarchy and of joint alignment, we predict actions on held-out gameplay with high-level goals ( Table 4 ; setup in Section C.6 ). Planner only generates actions directly with the planner; controller only uses an empty goal; cascade passes the planner’s decoded instructions as text to the Stage-2 controller; TaskFrame passes the aligned planner’s goal embeddings; and oracle goals uses annotated atomic instructions as an upper bound.
paragraphs.zh: 为了隔离层级结构本身以及联合对齐的价值，我们在留出的对局数据上结合高层目标来预测动作（表4；实验设置见C.6节）。 「仅规划器」直接用规划器生成动作；「仅控制器」使用空目标；「级联」将规划器解码出的指令以文本形式传递给第二阶段控制器；TaskFrame 传递对齐后的规划器目标嵌入；而「 oracle 目标」使用标注的原子指令作为性能上限。

sents.en: To isolate the value of the hierarchy and of joint alignment, we predict actions on held-out gameplay with high-level goals ( Table 4 ; setup in Section C.6 ).
sents.zh: 为了隔离层级结构本身以及联合对齐的价值，我们在留出的对局数据上结合高层目标来预测动作（表4；实验设置见C.6节）。

sents.en: Planner only generates actions directly with the planner; controller only uses an empty goal; cascade passes the planner’s decoded instructions as text to the Stage-2 controller; TaskFrame passes the aligned planner’s goal embeddings; and oracle goals uses annotated atomic instructions as an upper bound.
sents.zh: 「仅规划器」直接用规划器生成动作；「仅控制器」使用空目标；「级联」将规划器解码出的指令以文本形式传递给第二阶段控制器；TaskFrame 传递对齐后的规划器目标嵌入；而「 oracle 目标」使用标注的原子指令作为性能上限。

paragraphs.en: The planner alone beats the unconditioned controller, but it emits actions for a whole window from a single observation and cannot react within the window; the controller alone cannot tell which behavior is intended. The cascade recovers most of the gap, and the aligned goal embeddings of TaskFrame give the best results on all metrics; since both use the same decomposition, the gap between them isolates the effect of joint alignment. Oracle goals add little, so most remaining error lies in the controller rather than in the decomposition.
paragraphs.zh: 仅使用规划器就能胜过无条件的控制器，但它只根据单次观测为整个窗口生成动作，无法在窗口内做出反应；而仅使用控制器则无法判断预期的是哪种行为。 级联方式弥补了大部分差距，而 TaskFrame 的对齐目标嵌入在所有指标上都取得了最佳结果；由于两者使用相同的分解方式，二者之间的差距分离出了联合对齐的效果。 使用真实目标带来的提升很小，因此大部分剩余误差存在于控制器而非分解过程中。

paragraphs.en: We keep the trained model fixed and change only the goal it receives, evaluating each setting on the kill tasks with 48 episodes per task in each of three seeds ( Table 4 ; per-task results in Section C.5 ). With an empty goal, kill success drops from 51% to 25%; some success remains because every spawned animal is a valid target. A mismatched goal lowers it further to 13%, so the controller actively follows the goal rather than ignoring it, and withholding the observation from the planner costs 20 points, showing that the visual grounding of the goal helps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保持训练好的模型固定不变，仅更改其接收的目标，并在击杀任务上评估每种设置，每个任务在三个随机种子中各运行 48 个回合（表 4；各任务结果见 C.5 节）。 在目标为空时，击杀成功率从 51% 降至 25%；之所以仍有一定成功率，是因为每只生成的动物都是有效目标。 目标不匹配会使成功率进一步降至 13%，说明控制器是主动跟随目标而非忽略它；而从规划器中移除该观测会损失 20 分，表明目标的视觉定位（visual grounding）有所助益。

paragraphs.en: We compare the flow-matching camera head with the discrete head of Yue et al. (2026) , which classifies camera motion into bins and takes their expected value. The two controllers differ only in the camera head and are trained with the same data and schedule ( Table 5 ; setup in Section B.4 ). Flow matching lowers the mean absolute error from 2.1 ∘ to 1.7 ∘ for yaw and from 1.2 ∘ to 1.0 ∘ for pitch. Binning rounds small corrections to the nearest bin and averages over several plausible directions, which hurts most when aiming at a moving target.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将流匹配相机头与 Yue 等人 (2026) 的离散头进行比较，后者将相机运动分类到不同的区间并取其期望值。 两个控制器仅在相机头上有所不同，并使用相同的数据和训练计划进行训练（表 5；设置见第 B.4 节）。 流匹配将偏航的平均绝对误差从 2.1° 降低到 1.7°，俯仰从 1.2° 降低到 1.0°。 区间化会将小的修正舍入到最近的区间，并在多个可能的方向上取平均，这在瞄准移动目标时危害最大。

paragraphs.en: We presented TaskFrame, a hierarchical game agent that separates task-level planning from frame-level keyboard-and-mouse control. A vision-language planner, trained with supervised decomposition and dependency-aware GRPO, turns a high-level instruction into an ordered sequence of atomic goals and outperforms general-purpose models such as GPT-4o and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on instruction decomposition. The hidden states of the goal tokens in its plan serve as goal embeddings. A causal Transformer controller with a hybrid action head converts the active embedding and recent frames into native actions at every game step. In closed-loop Minecraft evaluation, the agent achieves the highest combat success rate among all evaluated models. Ablations further show that the controller relies on the goal condition and that the aligned goal embeddings are more effective than passing decoded text between the two modules.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 TaskFrame，一个将任务级规划与帧级键鼠控制相分离的分层游戏智能体。 视觉语言规划器通过监督分解和依赖感知的 GRPO 训练，将高层指令转化为有序的原子目标序列，在指令分解任务上超越了 GPT-4o 和 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 等通用模型。 其规划中目标词元的隐藏状态被用作目标嵌入。 带有混合动作头的因果 Transformer 控制器在每个游戏步骤中，将活跃嵌入和近期帧转换为原生动作。 在闭环 Minecraft 评估中，该智能体在所有受评估模型中取得了最高的战斗成功率。 消融实验进一步表明，控制器依赖于目标条件，且对齐的目标嵌入比在两个模块之间传递解码文本更为有效。

paragraphs.en: The agent does not decide on its own when an atomic goal is done, so it relies on an external execution protocol to switch to the next goal, and it does not replan after a failure. In addition, the controller sees only about one second of history, which is short for long-horizon tasks. Finally, all experiments are conducted in Minecraft, and extending the method to other games remains a challenging direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体无法自行判断一个原子目标何时完成，因此它依赖外部执行协议来切换到下一个目标，并且在失败后不会重新规划。 此外，控制器只能看到大约一秒的历史信息，这对于长时程任务来说太短了。 最后，所有实验都是在 Minecraft 中进行的，将该方法扩展到其他游戏仍然是一个具有挑战性的未来工作方向。

paragraphs.en: Our first SFT run balanced categories by duplicating minority examples. Its training loss decreased steadily, but on an external diagnostic built from VPT-20h (539 four-way questions over 498 clips that share no recordings with our training data; chance is 25%), accuracy fell to 39.5%, below the backbone’s 51.2%. Grouping questions by how closely the gold steps match the phrasing of the training annotations shows that the SFT model beats the backbone on the most familiar quartile (76.1% vs. 70.1%) but falls below chance on the least familiar one (17.0% vs. 35.6%). The model thus learns a narrow decomposition skill tied to annotation phrasing, which a clip-level holdout from the training distribution did not expose. These findings motivated our SFT recipe ( Section A.1 ): we balance categories by downsampling thematic examples instead of duplicating minority ones, describe each atomic target in two styles, and paraphrase high-level instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的首次 SFT 运行通过复制少数类样本来平衡各类别。 其训练损失稳步下降，但在一个基于 VPT-20h 构建的外部诊断集（539 道四选一题目，来自 498 个与训练数据无任何重叠记录的片段；随机基线为 25%）上，准确率降至 39.5%，低于骨干模型的 51.2%。 按照标准步骤与训练标注措辞的匹配程度对题目分组后发现，SFT 模型在最熟悉的四分位上优于骨干模型（76.1% 对 70.1%），但在最不熟悉的四分位上低于随机水平（17.0% 对 35.6%）。 因此，该模型学到的是一种与标注措辞绑定的狭窄分解技能，而来自训练分布的片段级留出集并未暴露出这一点。 这些发现促成了我们的 SFT 配方（第 A.1 节）：我们通过下采样主题类样本来平衡各类别，而不是复制少数类样本；用两种风格描述每个原子目标；并对高层指令进行改写。

paragraphs.en: The controller is trained on the VPT-100h gameplay of GameHorizon Suite ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , about 100 hours of first-person Minecraft play by human contractors ( Baker et al., 2022 ) with per-frame keyboard, mouse, and camera actions and atomic-instruction annotations; we use its 1,132 training clips and 35 validation clips at 20 fps and refer to it for data collection and annotation details. Frames are resized from 640 × 360 640\times 360 to 256 × 256 256\times 256 without cropping to preserve the full field of view, and GUI frames (inventory and crafting screens) are excluded. We split each clip into clean segments in which the instruction is constant and no GUI frame occurs, giving 33,392 segments; training windows are tiled inside a single segment, which removes the roughly 16% of windows that would otherwise straddle an instruction boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 控制器在 GameHorizon Suite（Wang et al., 2026）的 VPT-100h 游戏数据上训练，该数据集包含约 100 小时由人类承包商（Baker et al., 2022）进行的第一人称 Minecraft 游玩，附带逐帧的键盘、鼠标和相机动作以及原子指令标注；我们使用其中的 1,132 个训练片段和 35 个验证片段（帧率为 20 fps），数据收集与标注细节可参考该数据集。 帧图像从 640 × 360 640\times 360 缩放至 256 × 256 256\times 256，不做裁剪以保留完整视野，同时排除 GUI 帧（物品栏和合成界面）。 我们将每个片段切分为指令保持不变且不出现 GUI 帧的干净片段，共得到 33,392 个片段；训练窗口只在单个片段内平铺取用，从而去掉了原本会跨越指令边界的约 16% 的窗口。

paragraphs.en: The data is strongly long-tailed ( Figure 4 ). Moving forward occurs in 35.4% of frames and attacking in 20.9%, whereas using or placing items occurs in 3.5% and hotbar selection in only 0.3%; 54.7% of frames contain no key press. Combat accounts for only 3.2% of clean segments. We therefore oversample segments by category and by rare actions: combat segments by a factor of 6, placement and building by 3, and segments containing a use action by 1.5.
paragraphs.zh: 数据呈高度长尾分布（图 4）。 前进动作出现在 35.4% 的帧中，攻击出现在 20.9%，而使用或放置物品仅出现在 3.5% 的帧中，快捷栏选择仅占 0.3%；54.7% 的帧中没有任何按键操作。 战斗仅占干净片段的 3.2%。 因此，我们按类别和稀有动作对片段进行过采样：战斗片段以 6 倍采样，放置和建造以 3 倍采样，包含使用动作的片段以 1.5 倍采样。

paragraphs.en: The keyboard head predicts up to four simultaneous keys from 26 classes: no key, W, A, S, D, space (jump), left and right shift (sneak), left control (sprint), E (inventory), Q (drop), F (swap hands), Z, the four arrow keys, and hotbar slots 1–9. The mouse-button head predicts up to two simultaneous buttons from four classes (none, attack, use, middle). Both are decoded autoregressively from the action-output token. The flow-matching head predicts camera motion as yaw and pitch increments in degrees, converted from recorded pixel displacement at 0.15 ∘ per pixel and normalized by per-axis standard deviations estimated from the data (about 5 ∘ for yaw and 2 ∘ for pitch). Camera targets are masked on GUI frames.
paragraphs.zh: 键盘头从 26 个类别中预测最多四个同时按下的按键：无按键、W、A、S、D、空格（跳跃）、左右 shift（潜行）、左 control（疾跑）、E（物品栏）、Q（丢弃）、F（交换双手）、Z、四个方向键，以及快捷栏 1–9 号槽位。 鼠标按键头从四个类别（无、攻击、使用、中键）中预测最多两个同时按下的按键。 两者均从动作输出标记自回归地解码。 流匹配头以偏航角和俯仰角的度数增量预测相机运动，这些增量由记录的像素位移按每像素 0.15° 转换而来，并按从数据中估计的各轴标准差（偏航角约 5°，俯仰角约 2°）进行归一化。 在图形界面帧上，相机目标会被屏蔽。

paragraphs.en: During joint alignment (Stage 3), the adapted planner is additionally trained to describe the actions taken in the current window as a short sequence of action phrases, with a cross-entropy loss (weight 1.5) that up-weights rare action categories such as camera, interaction, and hotbar actions. The reported controller was additionally trained with an auxiliary video-prediction loss (weight 0.1): a branch initialized from Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B ( Wan Team, 2025 ) predicted 8 future frames from the controller’s hidden states and was discarded at inference, so it does not affect the policy’s architecture or inference cost. In our experiments, removing this loss had little effect on performance, and we do not consider it part of the method.
paragraphs.zh: 在联合对齐阶段（第 3 阶段），适配后的规划器还会被额外训练以一串简短的动作短语来描述当前窗口中采取的动作，使用交叉熵损失（权重 1.5），该损失对相机、交互和快捷栏动作等稀有动作类别进行了加权。 所报告的控制器还额外使用一个辅助视频预测损失（权重 0.1）进行训练：一个从 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 初始化的分支（Wan Team, 2025）根据控制器的隐藏状态预测 8 个未来帧，并在推理时被丢弃，因此它不影响策略的架构或推理成本。 在我们的实验中，移除该损失对性能影响很小，因此我们不将其视为方法的一部分。

The two controllers are identical except for the camera head, and both are trained with the same data and schedule and evaluated on the held-out VPT-100h validation split; results are in Table 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将流匹配相机头与离散头进行比较，后者按照 Yue et al. (2026) 的做法将相机运动分类到多个区间并预测其期望值。 两个控制器除相机头外完全相同，均使用相同的数据和训练计划进行训练，并在留出的 VPT-100h 验证集上进行评估；结果见表 5。

paragraphs.en: All tasks run in MineStudio ( Cai et al., 2024a ) with 256 × 256 256\times 256 observations for TaskFrame, a 400-step limit, and success defined as the first positive reward from the corresponding event. Mine tasks equip the agent with the required pickaxe or axe and fill a hollow 7 × 5 × 7 7\times 5\times 7 shell of the target block around it, so a target is visible and reachable from any direction; the instruction is, for example, “Mine stone blocks using a pickaxe.” Kill tasks equip an iron sword and spawn four target animals 2–6 blocks in front of the agent, with the instruction “Attack and kill the cow with a sword.”; the zombie task is run at night with night vision. Task configurations are frozen and shared across all compared models.
paragraphs.zh: 所有任务均在 MineStudio（Cai et al., 2024a）中运行，TaskFrame 使用 256 × 256 256\times 256 的观测，步数上限为 400，成功定义为从对应事件首次获得正奖励。 采矿任务为智能体配备所需的镐或斧，并在其周围填充目标方块构成的 7 × 5 × 7 7\times 5\times 7 空心壳层，使目标从任意方向都可见且可达；指令例如“使用镐开采石头方块。”。击杀任务为智能体配备铁剑，并在其前方 2–6 个方块处生成四个目标动物，指令为“用剑攻击并杀死奶牛。”；僵尸任务在夜间并开启夜视的情况下运行。 任务配置被冻结并在所有对比模型之间共享。

paragraphs.en: JARVIS-VLA-7B is served with vLLM and decoded with its own tokenized action space and μ \mu -law camera discretization at 640 × 360 640\times 360 , using the sampling temperature of its official rollout (0.9). UI-TARS-1.5-7B , which appears only in the qualitative comparison of Section C.4 , receives 640 × 360 640\times 360 observations with its native interleaved screenshot-and-action history, and each decision is held for 20 game steps because the model emits GUI events at well below 1 Hz. Its prompt describes the effect of each action without suggesting a strategy, and we sample with temperature 0.7, because greedy decoding on near-identical consecutive frames repeats the same action indefinitely. Its GUI events (click, drag, hotkey) are mapped to game actions by a fixed adapter.
paragraphs.zh: JARVIS-VLA-7B 通过 vLLM 提供服务，以自身的分词动作空间和 μ \mu 律相机离散化在 640 × 360 640\times 360 分辨率下进行解码，并使用其官方 rollout 的采样温度（0.9）。 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 仅出现在 C.4 节的定性比较中，它以原生的交错截图-动作历史接收 640 × 360 640\times 360 的观测，且每个决策保持 20 个游戏步骤，因为该模型输出 GUI 事件的频率远低于 1 Hz。 其提示词描述了每个动作的效果但不建议任何策略，我们以温度 0.7 进行采样，因为对几乎相同的连续帧进行贪婪解码会无限重复同一动作。 其 GUI 事件（点击、拖拽、热键）通过固定的适配器映射为游戏动作。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 compares rollouts of TaskFrame with those of the baselines on the same scenes; green and red bars mark successful and failed episodes. We additionally include the unified multimodal models BAGEL ( Deng et al., 2025 ) and SenseNova-U1 ( Diao et al., 2026 ) , run zero-shot through the same action adapter as UI-TARS-1.5-7B. On kill sheep, only TaskFrame succeeds: JARVIS-VLA-7B wanders without engaging the sheep, BAGEL turns the camera toward the sky and does not recover, UI-TARS-1.5-7B turns away from the targets, and SenseNova-U1 approaches a sheep but does not kill it. Mining oak logs is easier: TaskFrame, JARVIS-VLA-7B, and BAGEL succeed, whereas UI-TARS-1.5-7B remains in front of the wall without breaking it.
paragraphs.zh: 图6比较了TaskFrame与各基线方法在相同场景下的rollout结果；绿色和红色条分别标记成功和失败的回合。 我们额外纳入了统一多模态模型BAGEL（Deng et al., 2025）和SenseNova-U1（Diao et al., 2026），它们通过与UI-TARS-1.5-7B相同的动作适配器以零样本方式运行。 在kill sheep任务中，只有TaskFrame成功：JARVIS-VLA-7B四处游荡而不与绵羊互动，BAGEL将镜头转向天空且无法恢复，UI-TARS-1.5-7B背对目标转向，而SenseNova-U1接近了一只绵羊但未将其击杀。 采集橡木原木则较容易：TaskFrame、JARVIS-VLA-7B和BAGEL均成功，而UI-TARS-1.5-7B停留在墙前未能将其打破。

paragraphs.en: The comparison in Table 4 uses 50 clips that are disjoint from both planner and controller training, each annotated with a high-level goal and its temporally aligned atomic segments. paragraphs.en: TaskFrame doubles the zombie success of JARVIS-VLA-7B but fails the original stone task, whereas JARVIS-VLA-7B succeeds in 17% of episodes. Unlike the mining scenes of Table 1 , this task requires locating stone from a random spawn before mining, a search behavior that extends well beyond the controller’s one-second context and is rare in atomic training segments. We therefore attribute the gap to exploration rather than to block breaking, which TaskFrame performs reliably once the target is in view.
paragraphs.zh: TaskFrame 将 JARVIS-VLA-7B 的僵尸任务成功率提高了一倍，但在原有的石头任务上失败，而 JARVIS-VLA-7B 在 17% 的回合中成功。 与表 1 的挖矿场景不同，该任务需要在挖矿前从随机出生点定位石头，这种搜索行为远超控制器的 1 秒上下文范围，并且在原子训练片段中很少出现。 因此，我们将这一差距归因于探索而非方块破坏，因为一旦目标进入视野，TaskFrame 就能可靠地完成方块破坏。
